data.explanation: The pension insurer (Rentenversicherung) refused your application for a full disability pension, saying medical records show you can still do light work at least six hours a day and so are not considered disabled under German law (§ 43 SGB VI). If you disagree, you may file a written objection (Widerspruch); the app will show the deadline for this. If you miss it, the rejection becomes final. You could also get advice from the Agentur für Arbeit about employment support, or consult a lawyer or Sozialverband for help with an objection.
